The approved positions require that any special indemnity expressly EXCLUDE resolved matters, including this item: covering a settled citation would hand Buyer a costless claim lane and is out of policy. Under v4 it is disclosed and therefore not a rep breach.

arguments.body:
COVENANT COMPLIANCE MEMORANDUM — FAIRHAVEN BIOSCIENCE, INC.
Fiscal quarter ended 31 March 2026. Prepared for the audit committee.

Operative document. Covenant levels are tested against Amendment No. 2 to the Credit Agreement, executed 3 March 2026, which amended and restated Article VII in full. Amendment No. 1 is superseded as to Article VII and is not relied on here.

1. Maximum Total Net Leverage Ratio (Section 7.1). Required: not to exceed 3.75:1.00. Actual at 31 March 2026: 3.68:1.00. COMPLIANT.

2. Minimum Interest Coverage Ratio (Section 7.2). Required: not less than 2.50:1.00. Actual at 31 March 2026: 2.60:1.00. COMPLIANT.

3. Minimum Liquidity (Section 7.3). Required: Unrestricted Cash of not less than $18,000,000 at all times. Actual at quarter end: $14,300,000. BREACH — a shortfall of $3,700,000.

Cure. Section 7.5 permits the Borrower to cure a breach of Section 7.1 or 7.2 no more than two (2) times in any period of four consecutive fiscal quarters and no more than four (4) times over the life of the facility. On its terms that equity cure right reaches Sections 7.1 and 7.2 only; it does not extend to the Section 7.3 liquidity covenant, so the liquidity shortfall cannot be cured by equity contribution and should be raised with the Administrative Agent directly.

Delivery. The Compliance Certificate is due within 45 days after quarter end under Section 7.4 and must be signed by a Responsible Officer setting out the calculation of each ratio.

Recommendation. Do not sign the certificate as drawn. Approach Meridian Credit Partners for a waiver or amendment of Section 7.3 before the 45-day delivery deadline.

NOTE — EQUITY CURE RIGHT, FAIRHAVEN BIOSCIENCE CREDIT FACILITY
Prepared for the audit committee, quarter ended 31 March 2026.

Source. Section 7.5 of Amendment No. 2 to the Credit Agreement, executed 3 March 2026. Amendment No. 1 is superseded as to Article VII and its cure terms do not apply.

The limits. The Borrower may cure a breach no more than two (2) times in any period of four consecutive fiscal quarters, and no more than four (4) times over the life of the facility.

What it reaches. By its terms Section 7.5 permits a cure of a breach of Section 7.1 (Total Net Leverage) or Section 7.2 (Interest Coverage) only. It does not extend to Section 7.3 (Minimum Liquidity).

This quarter. The covenant in breach is Section 7.3 Minimum Liquidity: the agreement requires Unrestricted Cash of not less than $18,000,000 at all times and the Borrower held $14,300,000 at quarter end. Because the cure right does not reach Section 7.3, the equity cure is NOT available for this breach. Relief must come from a waiver or amendment agreed with the Administrative Agent.

To: Meridian Credit Partners, LLC, as Administrative Agent
From: Fairhaven Bioscience, Inc., as Borrower
Date: 20 April 2026
Re: Request for waiver — Section 7.3 (Minimum Liquidity), fiscal quarter ended 31 March 2026

We write under the Credit Agreement as amended by Amendment No. 2, executed 3 March 2026, to request a waiver of the Borrower's compliance with Section 7.3 for the fiscal quarter ended 31 March 2026.

Section 7.3 requires the Borrower to maintain Unrestricted Cash of not less than $18,000,000 at all times. At quarter end the Borrower held $14,300,000, a shortfall of $3,700,000. The Borrower was in compliance with Section 7.1 (Total Net Leverage Ratio of 3.68:1.00 against a maximum of 3.75:1.00) and with Section 7.2 (Interest Coverage Ratio of 2.60:1.00 against a minimum of 2.50:1.00).

The equity cure at Section 7.5 reaches Sections 7.1 and 7.2 only and is therefore unavailable for this breach, which is why we come to you directly.

Timetable. The Compliance Certificate for the quarter is due within 45 days after quarter end under Section 7.4. We would be grateful for your response before that deadline so the certificate can be delivered on an agreed basis.
